values.note: Water/electric $20, full hookup $25. Groups over 50 people pay $5 a person a day.

fees.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Floyd/Park/Tosanak-Recreation-Area/Activity/Camping (read 2026-11-04): '$20 per night for sites with water/electricity', '$25 per night for sites with water/electricity/sewer'; RV-Site-01..08 pages '$20 /Night'; 'Large groups over 50 individuals, will be charged a $5 per person per day fee'

values.note: Booked and paid on MyCountyParks; only RV sites #01-#08 (water/electric back-ins) are listed there as bookable facilities. Two-night minimum on the RV sites, three nights on Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day; kept as an exception to the no-standing-minimum rule (AWH 2026-10-10). Reservations are final; cancellations by phone forfeit the fees. Check-in after 3 pm, check-out before noon.

booking.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Floyd/Park/Tosanak-Recreation-Area/Facility/RV-Site-02/Availability (read 2026-11-04): '2 night minimum stay, Holidays 3 night stay (Memorial Day, 4th of July & Labor Day)', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 consecutive nights.', 'Check-in is after 03:00 PM and check-out is before 12:00 PM.', 'All reservations with Floyd County Conservation facilities are final.'; Activity/Camping: 'All sites are reserved/paid for via MyCountyParks.com'

values.note: Approximately May through October, weather and conditions permitting.

season.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Floyd/Park/Tosanak-Recreation-Area (read 2026-11-04), Operating Hours & Seasons: 'All camping and primitive cabins open seasonally from approximately May through October, weather and conditions permitting.'

note: Floyd County Conservation area 2 miles north of Marble Rock, a 370-acre former Scout reservation bordered on the west by the Shell Rock River. The RV loop's back-in gravel pads sit east of the park road in partial shade, well away from the river; primitive group areas, cabins and lodges elsewhere in the park. --Claude
summary: MyCountyParks pages: 27 RV sites at $20 water/electric and $25 full hookup, 30/50 amp, showers, dump, 2-night minimum (3 on holidays), 14-night max, season ~May-Oct. Corrected the note's location (Marble Rock, not Nora Springs) and dropped its field facts. Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: PHONE: none stored. Floyd County Conservation office 641-756-3490 (RV-Site-01 page: 'All cancellations must be made by calling the Floyd County Conservation office at 641-756-3490'). apply.py does not write phone.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. NAIP and the county facility map: the RV loop (diagonal back-ins #1-#27) is in the open east of the park road; the Shell Rock River (~45 m wide) runs ~370 m west of the loop through continuous woods. No site is on or in view of the river.
PIN: stored 42.98300,-92.89700 is in the woods ~130 m west of the RV loop (under the 250 m line). The loop centres at ~42.9830,-92.8954 if a re-pin is wanted.
COUNTS DISAGREE: the Camping page says 10 full-hookup + 17 water/electric; the park page says 10 water/electric + 17 full hookup. Total 27 either way; fields don't depend on the split.

ONLINE LISTING: only RV sites #01-#08 appear as bookable facilities on MyCountyParks, though the Camping page says all sites are reserved there; the other 19 may be seasonal or not yet listed (unverified).
